Given \(P(x)=x^2-x-6\) and \[\begin{gathered}Q(x) =x^3 -4x^2 -3x \\ +18\end{gathered}\].
(a) Factorise \(P(x)\) and \(Q(x)\).
(b) Find their G.C.D. and L.C.M.

已知 \(P(x)=x^2-x-6\) 及 \[\begin{gathered}Q(x) =x^3 -4x^2 -3x \\ +18\end{gathered}\]。
(a) 把 \(P(x)\) 及 \(Q(x)\) 因式分解。
(b) 求兩式的最大公因式及最小公倍式。

(a) \(P(x)=(x-3)(x+2)\). As \(Q(-2)=0\), division by \(x+2\) gives \(x^2-6x+9\), so \(Q(x)=(x+2)(x-3)^2\).
(b) Take minimum factor powers for the G.C.D. and maximum powers for the L.C.M.: G.C.D. \((x-3)(x+2)\); L.C.M. \((x+2)(x-3)^2\).

(i) Write down \(a,b\).

(a) Long division gives quotient \(x+1\) and remainder \(6x+5\).
(b)(i) Subtract the entire remainder: \(a=6,b=5\).
(ii) \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(2x^2-3x-9)(x+1) \\ =(2x+3)(x-3)(x+1)\end{gathered}\].
(iii) \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(x+1)(x+2)(x-3)\end{gathered}\]. Taking a common denominator leaves numerator \((2x+3)-(x+2)=x+1\). Cancel this factor to obtain \(\frac1{(x-3)(x+2)(2x+3)}\).

Let \(f(x)=4x^3-7x-3\).
(a) Show that \(2x+1\) is a factor of \(f(x)\).
(b) It is given that \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =f(x)\div(15-10x)\end{gathered}\].
(i) Express \(g(x)\) in terms of \(x\).
(ii) Hence find the minimum value of \(1-g(x)\).

設 \(f(x)=4x^3-7x-3\)。
(a) 證明 \(2x+1\) 是 \(f(x)\) 的因式。
(b) 已知 \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =f(x)\div(15-10x)\end{gathered}\]。
(i) 以 \(x\) 表示 \(g(x)\)。
(ii) 從而求 \(1-g(x)\) 的最小值。

(a) \[\begin{gathered}f(-\frac12) = \\ -\frac12 +\frac72 \\ -3 =0\end{gathered}\], so the factor theorem applies.
(b)(i) Division and factorisation give \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(2x+1)(2x-3)(x+1)\end{gathered}\]. Since \(15-10x=-5(2x-3)\), \[\begin{gathered}g(x) = \\ -\frac15(2x+1)(x+1)\end{gathered}\], with \(x\ne\frac32\).
(ii) Complete the square: \[\begin{gathered}1 -g(x) \\ =\frac25(x+\frac34)^2 \\ +\frac{39}{40}\end{gathered}\]. Its minimum is \(\frac{39}{40}\), attained at \(x=-\frac34\), which is allowed.

(a) \[\begin{gathered}f(-\frac12) = \\ -\frac12 +\frac72 \\ -3 =0\end{gathered}\]，由因式定理得證。
(b)(i) 相除及分解得 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(2x+1)(2x-3)(x+1)\end{gathered}\]。由 \(15-10x=-5(2x-3)\)，得 \[\begin{gathered}g(x) = \\ -\frac15(2x+1)(x+1)\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(x\ne\frac32\)。
(ii) 配方得 \[\begin{gathered}1 -g(x) \\ =\frac25(x+\frac34)^2 \\ +\frac{39}{40}\end{gathered}\]。最小值為 \(\frac{39}{40}\)，在容許值 \(x=-\frac34\) 取得。

fields.after:
A cubic polynomial \(f(x)\) has factor \(x+1\). When \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x^2-1\), the remainder is \(4x+k\), where \(k\) is an integer.
(a) Find \(k\).
(b) When \(f(x)\) is divided by \(-x\), the remainder is \(-4\). Someone claims that \(f(x)=0\) cannot have repeated roots different from \(-1\). Is the claim correct? Explain.

三次多項式 \(f(x)\) 有因式 \(x+1\)。\(f(x)\) 被 \(x^2-1\) 除的餘式為 \(4x+k\)，其中 \(k\) 為整數。
(a) 求 \(k\)。
(b) \(f(x)\) 被 \(-x\) 除的餘式為 \(-4\)。有人聲稱 \(f(x)=0\) 不可能有異於 \(-1\) 的重根。此說法正確嗎？解釋。

(a) Evaluate at \(-1\): \(0=-4+k\), so \(k=4\).
(b) Write \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =(x^2-1)(ax+b) \\ +4x +4\end{gathered}\], where \(a\ne0\) because the polynomial is cubic. Since \(f(0)=-4\), \(-b+4=-4\) gives \(b=8\).
Then \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(x+1)[ax^2+(8-a)x-4]\end{gathered}\]. The quadratic discriminant is \[\begin{gathered}(8-a)^2 +16a =a^2 \\ +64>0\end{gathered}\] for real \(a\), so its two roots are distinct. A repeated root could only arise when one coincides with the existing root \(-1\) (this happens at \(a=6\)). Thus no repeated root different from \(-1\) is possible; the claim is correct.

(a) 代入 \(-1\) 得 \(0=-4+k\)，故 \(k=4\)。
(b) 寫成 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =(x^2-1)(ax+b) \\ +4x +4\end{gathered}\]；因為是三次式，所以 \(a\ne0\)。由 \(f(0)=-4\)，得 \(-b+4=-4\)，故 \(b=8\)。
於是 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(x+1)[ax^2+(8-a)x-4]\end{gathered}\]。二次式的判別式為 \[\begin{gathered}(8-a)^2 +16a =a^2 \\ +64>0\end{gathered}\]，所以兩根相異。重根只可能來自其中一根與已有的 \(-1\) 重合（此時 \(a=6\)）。因此不可能有異於 \(-1\) 的重根，聲稱正確。
S4/more about polynomials/POLYNOMIALS REVIEWS 5.pdf · 第10題

fields.after: 下列哪個多項式的次數為 5？
For nonzero leading coefficients, degrees add in a product and multiply under powers. The four degrees are \(2+3=5\), \(3\times2=6\), \(5\times2=10\) and \(1+2+3=6\). Only A has degree 5.
非零首項係數的多項式相乘時次數相加，乘方時次數相乘。四個選項的次數依次為 \(2+3=5\)、\(3\times2=6\)、\(5\times2=10\)、\(1+2+3=6\)，故選 A。

fields.after: Let \(f(x)=3x^3-4x+k\). If \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(x-k\), find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x+k\).
設 \(f(x)=3x^3-4x+k\)。若 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x-k\) 整除，求它被 \(x+k\) 除的餘式。
From \(f(k)=0\), \(3k^3-3k=0\), hence \(k^3=k\). The required remainder is \[\begin{gathered}f(-k) = -3k^3 +5k \\ =2k\end{gathered}\]. This also holds when \(k=0\); do not divide by \(k\).
由 \(f(k)=0\) 得 \(3k^3-3k=0\)，故 \(k^3=k\)。所求餘式為 \[\begin{gathered}f(-k) = -3k^3 +5k \\ =2k\end{gathered}\]。\(k=0\) 時亦成立，不可直接除以 \(k\)。

fields.after: A polynomial is divided by \(x^2-3x+1\). The quotient and remainder are \(2x+3\) and \(6x+5\) respectively. Find the polynomial.
一多項式被 \(x^2-3x+1\) 除，商及餘式分別為 \(2x+3\) 及 \(6x+5\)。求該多項式。
Use dividend = divisor × quotient + remainder. Expanding \[\begin{gathered}(x^2-3x+1)(2x+3) \\ +(6x+5)\end{gathered}\] gives \(2x^3-3x^2-x+8\).
利用「被除式＝除式×商＋餘式」，展開 \[\begin{gathered}(x^2-3x+1)(2x+3) \\ +(6x+5)\end{gathered}\] 得 \(2x^3-3x^2-x+8\)。
